emonet.protocol: Mean expert rating mapped 0,1,2 → 0,5,10; 0–4 teacher-native emotion prediction multiplied by 2.5 and clipped to [0,10], a fixed endpoint conversion without benchmark fitting. Dataset snapshot has 42 queried labels; 40 map to trained emotion heads. Strict unanimous means all recorded raters agree and at least two raters.

emolia-dim.score_formula: negative absolute distance between predicted 0–6 ordinal VoiceNet score and queried level

crema.protocol: Published EmoNet-synonym crosswalk fixed before scoring. Each basic-label logit is log(mean(exp(training-reference z-score))) over its listed semantic heads. CREMA-D happy combines happy and calm heads because CREMA-D has no calm label. Neutral has no positive emotion head and receives logit 0 on the training-reference z scale. Ambiguous fine-grained states stay unassigned; no benchmark labels are used for fitting.
